subject: Exhibit handshake, MAP and evidence cadence for ClarityHealth order form
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Nathan Cole <nathan.cole@clarityhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Exhibit handshake, MAP and evidence cadence for ClarityHealth order form

Hi Nathan,

Thanks for sending the order form — we reviewed the exhibit and drafted a tightened version for clarity. Attached is clarity_exhibit_v3.docx with inline notes. High level asks from our side before legal proceeds to finalize: 

- Confirm target pen-test window (we've proposed a 2-week window in Q4; please confirm blackout dates).
- Scope boundary: we propose limiting full forensic access to non-production mirrors and a documented sample set; want to avoid live-customer data access unless absolutely required.
- Evidence cadence: draft suggests monthly delivery for artifacts (SOC2 reports, scan outputs). Can you confirm ClarityHealth's preferred cadence — monthly/quarterly/bi-weekly?
- Personnel & access: please provide names/roles for who will receive evidence and the technical owner for live access requests.

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP):
1) Legal alignment on language (this week)
2) Technical review and staging access plan (next week)
3) Pen-test scheduling & evidence delivery window (by 9/10)

Internal owners: Karthik (legal) will take the redline review; Laura will own evidence-ingest and artifact list; I will run the MAP and schedule the kickoff call.

Can you look at the attachment and call out any absolute must-haves by EOD tomorrow? If acceptable, I'll route the updated exhibit for signature via DocuSign and share a short Drive folder for evidence exchange.

Thanks,

Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0113

Attachments: clarity_exhibit_v3.docx (draft with inline notes)
From: Nathan Cole <nathan.cole@clarityhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@clarityhealth.com>, legal@clarityhealth.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 12:03:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Exhibit handshake, MAP and evidence cadence for ClarityHealth order form

Grace —

Appreciate the fast turn. Quick read-through from LegalOps and Security below; we've attached our redline (clarity_redline.pdf). Summary of our positions: 

- Pen test access: we need at least one option that allows production-scoped vulnerability verification for high-risk endpoints. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide time-boxed, monitored access and logs for that access?
- SOC2: we can accept quarterly attestations, but require a written escalation path if scope changes materially between reports.
- Evidence delivery: prefer bi-weekly for the first 60 days post-go-live, then monthly.
- Audit rights: we push back on language that implies unlimited inspection; prefer defined samples and a mutual notice period of 10 business days.

On the pen-test point, our security team will need to see the list of test cases and the expected blast radius. We can rotate the sample set but want a fallback if something needs immediate remediation.

Can Karthik and your legal team propose language that preserves our need for production verification while giving Redwood controls for RBAC and isolation?

Best,

Nathan Cole
Head of IT Security, ClarityHealth
nathan.cole@clarityhealth.com

Attachment: clarity_redline.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Nathan Cole <nathan.cole@clarityhealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 14:45:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Exhibit handshake, MAP and evidence cadence for ClarityHealth order form

Nathan / Marta / LegalOps —

Thanks for the clear positions. I reviewed the attached redline and sketched alternate language designed to meet both parties' operational controls and your need for production verification. Key proposals (see redline_comments.pdf):

1) Pen-test access (Section 4.2) — Replace "unrestricted inspection" with: "time-boxed, instrumented access to scoped production endpoints where Redwood provides session recording, audit logs, and a mutually agreed blast-radius mitigation plan. Access requires 10 business days' prior notice; emergency test exceptions may be granted by mutual written agreement."

2) SOC2 / evidence cadence — We can accept bi-weekly evidence deliveries for the initial 60-day onboarding window. After that, change to monthly deliveries with mandatory notification of scope-affecting changes (minimum 15 business days notice).

3) Sample set & fallback — Define a 3-tier sample: (A) staging mirror (default), (B) operational subset (read-only), (C) limited production verification (only by explicit joint approval). Each tier includes specific artifact lists (scan outputs, access logs, config snapshots).

Operational asks from ClarityHealth to unblock language:
- Confirm which data types (PHI/PII) cannot be part of any test artifacts or whether pseudonymization suffices.
- Provide names for the primary technical contacts and legal point of contact.

If you can accept the Section 4.2 wording above, I will fold the changes into clarity_exhibit_v3 and send a tracked DocuSign packet (prefer to keep order form signature separate from the Exhibit to avoid rework).

Grace / Laura — next steps: I recommend we finalize legal language today, schedule a technical scoping call tomorrow with ClarityHealth security, and then confirm pen-test calendar windows by next Friday.

Thanks,

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Appreciate the quick feedback and the pragmatic asks. That language from Karthik looks like a workable compromise to me. Next steps:

- I'll propose two time slots for a 30-min technical scoping call: Tue 8/25 10:00-10:30 PT or Wed 8/26 13:00-13:30 PT. Which works better?
- If we get a yes on the Section 4.2 wording and contacts, I'll route the updated exhibit for signature and share the Drive evidence folder.
